script:
# Inspect both files
cat("=== CSV file (head) ===\n")
csv_path <- "inputs/expression-matrix-444444444444.csv"
con <- file(csv_path, "r")
lines <- readLines(con, n = 5)
close(con)
cat(paste(lines, collapse = "\n"), "\n\n")
cat("=== CSV dimensions ===\n")
df_csv <- read.csv(csv_path, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
cat("Rows:", nrow(df_csv), "Cols:", ncol(df_csv), "\n")
cat("Column names:\n")
print(colnames(df_csv))
cat("\nFirst 3 rows:\n")
print(head(df_csv[, 1:6], 3))

# Inspect the differential analysis xlsx
xlsx_path <- "inputs/differential-results-333333333333.xlsx"
sheets <- readxl::excel_sheets(xlsx_path)
cat("Sheets in xlsx:", sheets, "\n\n")
for (s in sheets) {
  cat("=== Sheet:", s, "===\n")
  d <- readxl::read_excel(xlsx_path, sheet = s)
  cat("Rows:", nrow(d), "Cols:", ncol(d), "\n")
  cat("Columns:", paste(colnames(d), collapse = ", "), "\n")
  cat("First 3 rows:\n")
  print(head(d, 3))
  cat("\n")
}

# Re-read CSV with proper header (row 2 has sample IDs)
csv_path <- "inputs/expression-matrix-444444444444.csv"
raw <- read.csv(csv_path, header = FALSE, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
cat("Total rows:", nrow(raw), "Total cols:", ncol(raw), "\n")
cat("\nRow 1 (group labels):\n")
print(raw[1, ])
cat("\nRow 2 (sample IDs):\n")
print(raw[2, ])
# Look at the differential analysis file
xlsx_path <- "inputs/differential-results-333333333333.xlsx"
da <- readxl::read_excel(xlsx_path)
cat("\nDifferential analysis dimensions:", nrow(da), "x", ncol(da), "\n")
cat("First 5 rows:\n")
print(head(da, 5))
cat("\nLast 5 rows:\n")
print(tail(da, 5))
cat("\nlog2FoldChange summary:\n")
print(summary(da$log2FoldChange))
cat("\npvalue summary:\n")
print(summary(da$pvalue))
# Check if there are duplicate gene IDs in CSV
ids_raw <- raw[-c(1, 2), 1]
cat("\nUnique gene IDs in CSV (rows 3+):", length(unique(ids_raw)), "out of", length(ids_raw), "rows\n")
cat("Duplicate IDs (first 10):\n")
dup_ids <- ids_raw[duplicated(ids_raw)]
print(head(unique(dup_ids), 10))

# Load required packages
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggrepel)
  library(dplyr)
})
# Read raw CSV and parse properly (rows 1-2 are group/sample metadata)
csv_path <- "inputs/expression-matrix-444444444444.csv"
raw <- read.csv(csv_path, header = FALSE, check.names = FALSE,
                stringsAsFactors = FALSE, na.strings = c("", "NA"))
# Row 1: group labels (group1, group2); Row 2: sample IDs
sample_ids <- as.character(raw[2, -1])
groups     <- as.character(raw[1, -1])
gene_ids   <- raw[-c(1, 2), 1]
expr       <- as.matrix(raw[-c(1, 2), -1])
storage.mode(expr) <- "numeric"
rownames(expr) <- gene_ids
# De-duplicate: keep first occurrence
keep <- !duplicated(gene_ids)
expr <- expr[keep, , drop = FALSE]
gene_ids <- gene_ids[keep]
cat("After dedup:", nrow(expr), "genes x", ncol(expr), "samples\n")
cat("Samples:", paste(sample_ids, collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Groups:  ", paste(groups, collapse = ", "), "\n")
# Define contrasts within each cell line
is_cohort_a_ctrl <- sample_ids %in% c("CohortActrl1", "CohortActrl2", "CohortActrl4")
is_cohort_a_si   <- sample_ids %in% c("CohortAsi1", "CohortAsi2", "CohortAsi5")
is_cohort_b_ctrl <- sample_ids %in% c("CohortBctrl1", "CohortBctrl2", "CohortBctrl4")
is_cohort_b_si   <- sample_ids %in% c("CohortBsi1", "CohortBsi2", "CohortBsi3")
cat("\nCohortA ctrl samples:", sum(is_cohort_a_ctrl), " | CohortA si samples:", sum(is_cohort_a_si), "\n")
cat("CohortB ctrl samples:", sum(is_cohort_b_ctrl), " | CohortB si samples:", sum(is_cohort_b_si), "\n")
# Differential expression via Welch t-test on log2-expression values
ttest_pvals <- function(mat_a, mat_b) {
  p <- apply(mat_a, 1, function(a) {
    b <- mat_b[which(rownames(mat_b) == rownames(mat_a) %>% as.character()), ]
    tryCatch(t.test(a, b)$p.value, error = function(e) NA_real_)
  })
  p
}
# Subset: ensure row order is consistent
ctrl_cohort_a <- t(expr[, is_cohort_a_ctrl])
si_cohort_a   <- t(expr[, is_cohort_a_si])
ctrl_cohort_b <- t(expr[, is_cohort_b_ctrl])
si_cohort_b   <- t(expr[, is_cohort_b_si])
# Compute log2FoldChange (si - ctrl, already on log2 scale → simple difference)
cohort_a_log2fc <- colMeans(si_cohort_a) - colMeans(ctrl_cohort_a)
cohort_b_log2fc <- colMeans(si_cohort_b) - colMeans(ctrl_cohort_b)
# Compute p-values via Welch t-test, vectorised
cohort_a_p <- apply(expr, 1, function(g) {
  v <- as.numeric(g)
  tryCatch(t.test(v[is_cohort_a_si], v[is_cohort_a_ctrl])$p.value, error = function(e) NA_real_)
})
cohort_b_p <- apply(expr, 1, function(g) {
  v <- as.numeric(g)
  tryCatch(t.test(v[is_cohort_b_si], v[is_cohort_b_ctrl])$p.value, error = function(e) NA_real_)
})
cat("\nCalculated CohortA_log2FC for TSPAN6:", round(cohort_a_log2fc["TSPAN6"], 3),
    " | CohortB_log2FC:", round(cohort_b_log2fc["TSPAN6"], 3), "\n")
cat("CohortA p-value:", signif(cohort_a_p["TSPAN6"], 3), " | CohortB p-value:", signif(cohort_b_p["TSPAN6"], 3), "\n")

# Build the result table for plotting
padj_cohort_a <- p.adjust(cohort_a_p, method = "BH")
padj_cohort_b <- p.adjust(cohort_b_p, method = "BH")
res <- data.frame(
  gene        = names(cohort_a_log2fc),
  log2FC_CohortA  = as.numeric(cohort_a_log2fc),
  log2FC_CohortB  = as.numeric(cohort_b_log2fc),
  p_CohortA       = as.numeric(cohort_a_p),
  p_CohortB       = as.numeric(cohort_b_p),
  padj_CohortA    = as.numeric(padj_cohort_a),
  padj_CohortB    = as.numeric(padj_cohort_b),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
res <- res[is.finite(res$log2FC_CohortA) & is.finite(res$log2FC_CohortB), ]
# Classify genes into four significance categories
fc_cut   <- 1.0   # |log2FC| threshold
sig_cut  <- 0.05  # BH-adjusted p-value threshold
res$SigCohortA <- with(res, abs(log2FC_CohortA) >= fc_cut & padj_CohortA < sig_cut)
res$SigCohortB <- with(res, abs(log2FC_CohortB) >= fc_cut & padj_CohortB < sig_cut)
res$Category <- with(res, ifelse(
  SigCohortA &  SigCohortB,  "Both significant",
  ifelse(SigCohortA & !SigCohortB, "Significant in CohortA only",
  ifelse(!SigCohortA & SigCohortB, "Significant in CohortB only",
                      "Not significant")))
)
cat("Category counts:\n")
print(table(res$Category))
cat("\nTop genes by combined significance (|log2FC_CohortA|+|log2FC_CohortB|):\n")
top <- res %>%
  mutate(score = abs(log2FC_CohortA) + abs(log2FC_CohortB)) %>%
  arrange(desc(score)) %>%
  head(15)
print(top[, c("gene", "log2FC_CohortA", "log2FC_CohortB", "padj_CohortA", "padj_CohortB", "Category")])

# With only n=3 per group, BH adjustment removes everything. Use raw p-value
# and a softer FC cutoff (log2(1.5) ≈ 0.585) to surface biologically interesting genes.
fc_cut   <- log2(1.5)   # ≈ 0.585
sig_cut  <- 0.05        # raw p-value
res$SigCohortA <- with(res, abs(log2FC_CohortA) >= fc_cut & p_CohortA < sig_cut)
res$SigCohortB <- with(res, abs(log2FC_CohortB) >= fc_cut & p_CohortB < sig_cut)
res$Category <- with(res, ifelse(
  SigCohortA &  SigCohortB,  "Both significant",
  ifelse(SigCohortA & !SigCohortB, "Significant in CohortA only",
  ifelse(!SigCohortA & SigCohortB, "Significant in CohortB only",
                      "Not significant")))
)
cat("Category counts (raw p<0.05, |log2FC|>=log2(1.5)):\n")
print(table(res$Category))
# Pick top labels (most extreme combined fold change among significant genes)
res$absFCsum <- abs(res$log2FC_CohortA) + abs(res$log2FC_CohortB)
res$labelled  <- res$Category != "Not significant"
labelled_pool <- res[res$labelled, ]
top_lab <- labelled_pool %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(absFCsum)) %>%
  head(20)
cat("\nGenes to label:\n")
print(top_lab[, c("gene", "log2FC_CohortA", "log2FC_CohortB", "p_CohortA", "p_CohortB", "Category")])

# ====== DIAGONAL VOLCANO PLOT ======
# Main panel: log2FC_CohortA (x) vs log2FC_CohortB (y)
# Diagonal y = x represents equal siRNA effect in both cell lines.
# Quadrants:
#   upper-right : up in BOTH    lower-left : down in BOTH
#   upper-left  : up in CohortB only lower-right : up in CohortA only
cat_levels <- c("Both significant", "Significant in CohortA only",
                "Significant in CohortB only", "Not significant")
cat_colors <- c("Both significant"         = "#D7263D",
                "Significant in CohortA only"  = "#1B998B",
                "Significant in CohortB only"  = "#3D5A80",
                "Not significant"          = "grey75")
res$Category <- factor(res$Category, levels = cat_levels)
# Label set: top genes by combined |log2FC| within "not Not significant"
lab_df <- top_lab
p_main <- ggplot(res, aes(x = log2FC_CohortA, y = log2FC_CohortB)) +
  # background quadrants (light tint)
  annotate("rect", xmin = -Inf, xmax = 0, ymin = 0,    ymax = Inf,
           fill = "#FFF4E6", alpha = 0.45) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = 0,    xmax = Inf, ymin = -Inf, ymax = 0,
           fill = "#FFF4E6", alpha = 0.45) +
  # points
  geom_point(aes(fill = Category, size = Category, alpha = Category),
             shape = 21, colour = "grey25", stroke = 0.15) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cat_colors, drop = FALSE,
                    guide = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 4))) +
  scale_size_manual(values = c("Both significant"        = 2.8,
                               "Significant in CohortA only" = 2.4,
                               "Significant in CohortB only" = 2.4,
                               "Not significant"         = 1.0), guide = "none") +
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c("Both significant"        = 0.95,
                                "Significant in CohortA only" = 0.85,
                                "Significant in CohortB only" = 0.85,
                                "Not significant"         = 0.35), guide = "none") +
  # diagonal y = x (equal effect)
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed",
              colour = "grey30", linewidth = 0.45) +
  # axes at 0
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted", colour = "grey50", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted", colour = "grey50", linewidth = 0.3) +
  # fold-change thresholds
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-fc_cut, fc_cut), linetype = "dotdash",
             colour = "#1B998B", linewidth = 0.3, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(-fc_cut, fc_cut), linetype = "dotdash",
             colour = "#3D5A80", linewidth = 0.3, alpha = 0.7) +
  # top gene labels
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    data = lab_df,
    aes(label = gene),
    size = 3, fontface = "italic", colour = "black",
    max.overlaps = 100, box.padding = 0.4, segment.colour = "grey40",
    segment.size = 0.25, min.segment.length = 0
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-3.5, 3.5),
                     breaks = seq(-3, 3, 1),
                     expand = expansion(mult = 0.02)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-3.5, 3.5),
                     breaks = seq(-3, 3, 1),
                     expand = expansion(mult = 0.02)) +
  labs(
    title    = "Diagonal volcano plot — siRNA effect in CohortA vs CohortB cell lines",
    subtitle = "x: log2FC (CohortA siRNA vs control) | y: log2FC (CohortB siRNA vs control)",
    x = "log2 Fold Change  (CohortA: siRNA − control)",
    y = "log2 Fold Change  (CohortB: siRNA − control)",
    fill = NULL,
    caption = paste0(
      "Cutoffs: |log2FC| ≥ log2(1.5) ≈ ", round(fc_cut, 2),
      " ; raw p < 0.05  (Welch t-test, n = 3 vs 3)\n",
      "Dashed diagonal = equal siRNA effect in both cell lines"
    )
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, colour = "grey30"),
    plot.caption  = element_text(hjust = 0, colour = "grey40", size = 9),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position  = c(0.99, 0.01),
    legend.justification = c("right", "bottom"),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "grey70"),
    legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm")
  )
# Save
ggsave("diagonal_volcano.png", p_main, width = 8.5, height = 7.5, dpi = 300)
ggsave("diagonal_volcano.pdf", p_main, width = 8.5, height = 7.5)
cat("Saved: diagonal_volcano.png (", file.info("diagonal_volcano.png")$size,
    " bytes)\n", sep = "")
